sloka: यथा ऽयं मामभिक्रुद्धः समभिद्रवति स्वयम्।वधिष्यति सनाथां मामनाथामिव दुर्मतिः ।। ६.९३.४९ ।।
transliteration: yathā 'yaṁ māmabhikruddhaḥ samabhidravati svayam।vadhiṣyati sanāthāṁ māmanāthāmiva durmatiḥ ।। 6.93.49 ।।

translations.english: Thus spoke Sita filled with sorrow crying," This evil minded angry one is coming to me to kill me as though I am an orphan even though I have a protector."
